sourceState: Uncommitted working tree. Exact tracked diff and relevant new sources preserved under .build/native-beta-100.
changes: Automatic participation can invite a named attendee's question or acknowledge a verified inbound audio check in the assistant's own words.
The host binds fixed replies to the verified current turn. An independent current-turn classifier checks the cue and addressee.
Successful Start remembers the approved reply channel for later setup. Typed decision progress and English and Russian labels identify silent outcomes.
validation: 34 targeted native tests passed, including Russian voice admission and private text fallback, and both no-hardware WebRTC spikes.

With the release audio-route-r1 framework, the remote WebRTC decoder measured 0.15823 assistant RMS over 41,280 samples while the local monitor played. The simulated microphone gate and canceled assistant channel both measured zero.
Two Apple on-device model replays each approved both directed Russian prompts and refused both a room-wide sound check and a later turn after a human answered.
Independent source review, 27 distribution tests, signed application localization checks, app notarization and public beta download SHA-256 verification passed.
diagnosisLimit: Build 99 accepted identified room audio but had no automatic synthesis event. Its diagnostics cannot identify the exact reason that turn stopped before synthesis. Synthetic Apple model replays reproduced fixed-action structural rejection and overbroad classification in unpublished candidates.
notVerified: Live meeting delivery through the provider SFU with the user's configured model and voice clone.
